spec_match.rationale: Logs every wheel event with its momentum value and shows an honest upfront banner: '⚠ WheelEvent.momentum is not supported in this browser. Events will show momentum as undefined.'

interactive.rationale: Synthetic wheel events dispatched to the scroll area logged live entries ('deltaY:40 momentum: undefined @2511ms') in the driven run.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised per-event momentum log with fling instructions.

edge_cases.rationale: Unsupported branch is honestly labelled and each event's momentum is printed verbatim rather than coerced.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 0 pass / 2 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: three dispatched wheel events each produced a timestamped log row with momentum: undefined; zero console errors.

accessibility.rationale: Wheel-only interaction with no keyboard alternative and the event log is not a live region.

openQuestions.title: Make the event log a live region with a non-wheel trigger
openQuestions.detail: role=log on the event list plus a sample-event button would open the demo to keyboard users; today only pointer-wheel input feeds it.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: dispatched three wheel events into the scroll area; each logged 'deltaY:40 momentum: undefined' under the honest unsupported banner; zero console errors.
